name: canal-youtube
description: Bolota & Palito — estúdio de desenho animado programático (Remotion) para YouTube Shorts

scripts.render:ep01: npm run audio && remotion render Ep01CafeSegunda out/ep01-cafe-segunda.mp4
scripts.render:ep02: npm run audio && remotion render Ep02SenhaPerfeita out/ep02-senha-perfeita.mp4
scripts.render:ep03: npm run audio && remotion render Ep03Despertador out/ep03-despertador.mp4
scripts.brand: remotion still ProfilePicture out/brand/foto-perfil.png && remotion still ChannelBanner out/brand/banner.png && remotion still PromoPost out/brand/post-divulgacao.png
